violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler
violation_type.typical_finding: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.

finding_variants.text: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.
At time of inpsection, one out of the seven classrooms observed did not have children's name labeled on training cups.
I observe training cups and feeding bottles not labeled with child's name. Note: corrected when bottles removed.
During the inspection bottles and training cups were observed without individual labels with names. This was corrected by the provider labeling the bottles during the inspection.

During inspection, one bottle of milk was observed to have no name or label to identify the child to whom it belongs.    This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver labeled the bottle with the child's name.
Mutiple training cups were observed to not have the child's name labeled.
